items.title: Bill Charlap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: my trio is Kenny Washington and Peter Washington. And we’ve been playing together for the last two and a half years or so.

ctx.x: You have a crew of musicians that you like to call in your own trio now?

Well my trio is Kenny Washington and Peter Washington. And we’ve been playing together for the last two and a half years or so. And there’s a very natural connection between us, a very natural feeling about what we care about, what are the central forces that we — just a sort of center current to the things we care about musically, that’s all. And we don’t really need to discuss very much. We never have. The approach happens very naturally. Both guys have great command, great understanding of their instruments…
When we meet again down the line somewhere, can you envision things that will hopefully happen in your career for you?
